title: Doja Cat & SZA Give Surprise Performances at Summer Walker’s Los Angeles Show
summary: It was ladies' night at Crypto.com Arena.
contentText:
Summer Walker brought the Still Finally Over It Tour to Los Angeles on Thursday night (June 25), and she had a few surprises in store for the fans filling Crypto.com Arena.

It was ladies’ night in Los Angeles. In the midst of Summer’s set, which found her perched atop a white piano, the singer welcomed SZA and Doja Cat to the stage. Both special guests made appearances separately.

Rocking a flowery dress, SZA popped out and drew a roar from the crowd. She took it back to 2017 to perform “The Weekend,” which landed on her Ctrl debut album and reached No. 29 on the Billboard Hot 100.

Solána also made sure to give Summer her flowers before leaving the stage, as fan-captured videos showed. “Congratulations on your sold-out tour. I’ve been watching videos online. You look beautiful, you sound beautiful. I’m so proud of you. You’re incredible,” she gushed about her “No Love” collaborator.

Doja Cat followed , stunning in a purple corset and matching skirt. Coming off touring throughout Europe, the Grammy-winning superstar’s vocals were on point as she performed Scarlet standout “Agora Hills.” The 2023 glitzy slow-jam reached the Hot 100’s top 10, where it peaked at No. 7 in February 2024.

Summer Walker recruited Doja for Finally Over It ‘s “Go Girl” alongside Latto. Finally Over It served as the third and final installment of her album series, which notched a No. 2 debut on the Billboard 200 last year.

With a few more North American shows left, the Still Finally Over It Tour continues on Friday (June 26) in Las Vegas before heading to Oakland on Sunday (June 28).
